properties.description: Cyclobutene minimum. The pre-reaction complex of this unimolecular ring opening is cyclobutene itself; no separate complex exists.

C2-symmetric conrotatory saddle. One imaginary frequency -728.30 cm^-1 (terminal methylene rotation coupled to C3-C4 cleavage). r(C1=C2)=1.379, r(C1-C4)=r(C2-C3)=1.429, r(C3-C4)=2.143 A; the two methylene torsions are equal in magnitude and opposite in sense.
properties.combined_opt_freq_note: Single native Gaussian log with Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigentest)+Freq at the workflow-verified saddle geometry: Stationary point found, 1 imaginary frequency (-728.30 cm^-1), E = -155.816517681 Ha. Cross-checked against ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0004/frequency/frequency.log (same energy) and the workflow's verified TS verdict.

properties.description: s-cis-butadiene minimum (the conformer actually reached by the conrotatory IRC; C4-C1-C2-C3 dihedral about -27 deg). Not substituted by any s-trans value.

properties.barrier_definition: DeltaE(double dagger) = E(TS1) - E(RC) in kcal/mol, electronic energies only, no ZPE or thermal correction
properties.bond_change_rationale: Atom map labels from [CH:1]1=[CH:2][CH2:3][CH2:4]1. Over the step the C1=C2 pi bond drops to the central single bond of butadiene (2 -> 1, break [1,2]), the C3-C4 ring sigma bond is fully cleaved (1 -> 0, break [3,4]), and the two terminal double bonds C1=C4 and C2=C3 are formed (1 -> 2, form [1,4] and [2,3]).
